Milestone F: proving the production Path A owner-owned root-of-trust story on ROCK 5B / RK3588 (primary) and ROCKPro64 / RK3399 (secondary): DDR/TPL blob licensing and checksums, TF-A Trusted Board Boot and ROTPK rehearsal, OP-TEE / StandaloneMM / RPMB UEFI variables / ms-tpm-20-ref fTPM bring-up, U-Boot UEFI Secure Boot with TCG2 measurement, booting the shared signed UKI with /usr verification and FIDO2 unlock

Milestone Docs: preventing snapshot drift — dated refs/ planning notes per research cycle, keeping run-specific image digests out of prose (PINNED.md is the pin home), keeping RestrictFileSystems= and RestrictFileSystemAccess= distinct in hardening docs, and CITATION.md primary-source preference
